newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: SOCCER-DOZENS KILLED AT GUATEMALA SOCCER STADIUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DOZENS KILLED AT GUATEMALA SOCCER STADIUM.

text.p: An avalanche of soccer fans tumbled down a flight of stairs into more spectators at a World Cup soccer qualifying match Wednesday, killing at least 79 people and leaving more than 150 injured, witnesses said.
Some of the people died from suffocation in the crush of bodies. A Reuters photographer counted 79 bodies at the stadium at the match between between Guatemala and Costa Rica.
